'''YD-33''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] used by the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed on the ''[[Ziost Shadow]]'', YD-33 asked an Imperial to rendezvous with Ambassador [[Rove (Ambassador)|Rove]] regarding the situation with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
